pools.name: windows-11-eval
pools.probe: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $h=$env:USERPROFILE; foreach($d in 'Desktop','Documents','Downloads','Pictures','Music','Videos'){ Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Force (Join-Path $h $d) | Sort-Object FullName | ForEach-Object { '{0}|{1}' -f $_.FullName.Substring($h.Length), $(if($_.PSIsContainer){'d'}else{$_.Length}) } }; Get-ChildItem -Force C:\Users\Public\Desktop | ForEach-Object { 'pub|'+$_.Name }; foreach($k in 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize','HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced','HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop','HKCU:\Environment','HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse','HKCU:\Control Panel\International'){ $p=Get-ItemProperty $k; if($p){ $p.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Name -notlike 'PS*' -and $_.Name -notmatch '{EXCLUDE}' } | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { $k+'|'+$_.Name+'='+$_.Value } } }; (Get-TimeZone).Id; Get-ChildItem -Force C:\Users\Public\drums_canary_* | ForEach-Object { 'canary|'+$_.Name }
